category_title: At-risk students in technical tracks who exhibit attention-seeking behaviors, restlessness, and kinetic learning needs
minimal_context: The student is using SONAR software and headphones in the keyboard lab to learn their individual instrumental parts for 'Count On Me'.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please put on your headphones and use the SONAR software to learn your individual instrumental parts for 'Count On Me'.

STUDENT: I am not sure what we are doing. I am a bit blur.

TUTOR: Just look at the software and try to figure it out on your own.

STUDENT: (Plays a few notes on the keyboard) I am practising but it is a bit blurred.

TUTOR: Keep working on it individually and quietly.

STUDENT: (Takes off headphones and stops doing his work for some time) I am frustrated because I cannot figure out what to do.

options.A: Implement relatively tight timelines for completing the individual instrumental parts on the keyboard.
options.B: Provide a curated list of online resources for independent study outside of the lab.
options.C: Ask the student what they think went wrong with the software instead of telling them.
options.D: Prompt, model, role-play, and explicitly teach desired social-emotional behaviors during the lab session.
